owner: owner review of S99 and 'PEE — Next R3 Step: Rule Governance and Operational Semantic Correction' (verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-review-s99-rule-governance-2026-10-20.md): 'Validate first with regression baselines and controlled tests on existing material, then with an independent evaluation on genuinely unseen documents. Keep S99's operational gates and ranking restrictions intact.'
writtenBefore: any fetch of the check pages, any annotation and any run on them

builds.s100: commit 8f982dc (reader sr100.1, rules os.2, definitions pd.9; frozen after development it0-it2 on spent S89-S99 material: two of three reformulations used)
builds.s99: commit 2032a3a (reader sr99.1), the current gated reading
builds.runner: scripts/s99-integrity.mjs LABEL --set check --wave s100/wave --out s100 [--build DIR]: the same script for every build

material.plan: about six to eight pages never examined by PEE from at least three publishers never used (none of the 73 hosts of earlier waves), chosen to contain the S99 blocker: publisher test-result TABLES next to maker specification tables or claims, prose that states a claim and a result in one sentence, and a maker page. Candidates in order: smartairfilters.com (air purifier tests with measured tables), stereophile.com (loudspeaker and amplifier reviews: maker specifications and a separate Measurements section), a maker's product or explainer page (levoit.com, coway, blueair), then soundstage network or cleanairkits if a candidate refuses. Fetched only through scripts/phase246-live-wave.mjs under the standing policy; robots refusals, AI-agent refusals, Content-Signal ai-input=no and 403/429 are recorded and never bypassed
material.items: scripts/s99-check.mjs items --wave s100/wave: every quantity with a QK unit in the page's text blocks (the reader that finds more quantities), deduplicated, evenly sampled, at most 20 per page; table rows are text blocks and are sampled like prose

reference.definitions: the S99 shared annotation guide (private-eval/s99/wave/annotation/GUIDE.md), unchanged, with its hard examples from SPENT pages; plus one paragraph for tables written before annotation: 'A value in a table takes the role the table, its column header or its section states (a Measurements table of the reviewer: result; a manufacturer's specifications table: specification); the table's position on the page does not decide it.'
reference.annotators: two blind Claude agents annotate every item independently (no system output, no PEE code)
reference.adjudication: a third blind agent resolves every disagreement and checks every no_fitting_label; the merged reference is sealed by SHA-256 in evaluation/s100/check-annotation-freeze.json before any run
reference.agreement: inter-annotator agreement per field is reported before adjudication

metrics.preservation: as S99 (fields changed between reading and store; product links without a stated subject)
metrics.attribution: as S99 (correct, wrong, not stored; false product values; label gaps)
metrics.statementRole: precision among decided readings and abstentions, overall AND per reader (Phase245 rows, Phase265 leads, prose)
metrics.blocker: B1: reference results read from table rows (Phase245) stored as specifications; B2: reference specifications stored as results (any reader)
metrics.nature: precision among decided readings and abstentions
metrics.subject: as S99
metrics.comparability: verdicts of cross-product pairs with reasons
metrics.advice: 206 regression requests: decisions and shortlists unchanged with the gated consumer on

stopRules.S1_integrity: any reading field changed between reading and store, or any product link without a stated subject: S100 is not adopted
stopRules.S2_no_new_false_attribution: S100 may not produce more false product values, nor link more other-product or no-product values to the reviewed product, than S99 on these pages
stopRules.S3_role_and_nature: precision among decided readings must not be lower than S99's for statement role and for nature; abstentions are reported separately
stopRules.S5_blocker: B1 must be lower than S99's when S99's is above 0, and 0 when S99's is 0; B2 must not exceed S99's
stopRules.outcome: if S1-S5 hold, the S100 reader replaces the S99 reader as the GATED operational reading; otherwise the S99 reader stays and the failing rule is documented. In every case the path stays disabled for decisions and ranking, and S99's operational gates stay as they are.

reportedNotGated: abstentions and coverage (reviewed-product values correctly stored and linked), which the development run showed falling (S99 98, S100 81 of 603): reported as a cost, not hidden
notClaimed: no ranking, no recommendation, no promotion of any definition; R3 stays open; development figures on spent material are never reported as independent

addendumTables.writtenBefore: any fetch of the supplementary pages, after the first run of the main check
addendumTables.why: the 7 main-check pages contain no HTML table (figures are images or scripts), so the table blocker B1 was not exercised: it held only vacuously. The main first run stays committed unchanged and is reported as such.
addendumTables.material: 3-5 pages with HTML tables of the publisher's own measurements, from publishers never used: lygte-info.dk (battery and charger tests: rated against measured capacity tables), storagereview.com (SSD reviews: specification tables and measured benchmark tables); fallbacks: servethehome.com, hardwarecanucks.com. Same wave script, policy and refusal rules
addendumTables.items: scripts/s99-check.mjs items --wave s101/wave (same procedure; table rows are text blocks)
addendumTables.reference: the same guide (S100 GUIDE.md with §7 on tables), two new blind annotators and a blind adjudicator; sealed in evaluation/s101/check-annotation-freeze.json before any run
addendumTables.builds: s100 8f982dc and s99 2032a3a, same runner (--wave s101/wave --out s101)
addendumTables.stopRules: S1-S5 as above; B1 is the primary measure of this addendum. The adoption decision requires S1-S5 on BOTH checks; if B1 fails here, S100 is not adopted and the table rule is documented
